caseName: Sac & Fox Nation Oklohama v. Borough of Jim Thorpe
caseNameFull: SAC AND FOX NATION OF OKLOHAMA v. BOROUGH OF JIM THORPE, PENNSYLVANIA

opinions.text: Motion of Senator Ben Nighthorse Campbell, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of National Congress of American Indians for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
